description: A two-prompt Gemini Flash source run that produced a self-contained browser page for entering leftovers, owner/date/location/shelf-life, generating printable labels, and sorting a use-first list.

artifact_versions.notes: Prompt 1 real generated artifact. It matched the workflow but rendered typed food/owner values through innerHTML, so prompt 2 was justified as a safety/robustness fix.

verification_notes: Verified final artifact over local HTTP at http://127.0.0.1:8192/artifacts/fridge-leftover-label-printer-gemini-v2.html in Chrome. It rendered nonblank with Add Leftover, Use First List, Printable Labels, and Print Labels controls. Added a leftover using food text " Chili", owner "Drew & family", and 2 days lasting; the use-first list and printable label rendered those values as literal text, no img element was created, no alert fired, and one label/delete control appeared. Console warning/error logs were empty during verification. Static source scan found no external scripts, links, fonts, or imports in either artifact. Desktop scroll width equaled client width. Narrow/mobile fit was checked by source review: the form grid uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)), labels use repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)), the container is max-width 800px with viewport-width body flow, and inputs/selects use box-sizing border-box; exact Chrome viewport resizing was not exposed by the available Chrome API.
result_content: A self-contained leftover label printer/planner that creates printable labels and a use-first list from food, owner, date, fridge/freezer location, and shelf-life inputs.
